company.shortDescription: Avoca Systems provides AI software that automates radiology scheduling, referrals, calls, and patient communications.
company.description: Avoca Systems provides AI software for radiology networks. Its platform automates calls, online scheduling, e-referrals, appointment confirmations, reminders, preparation instructions, results delivery, and follow-up communications. The platform also encodes clinic rules, clinical protocols, and operational workflows so they can guide patient interactions and scheduling. It integrates with radiology information systems, electronic health records, practice-management systems, and telephony infrastructure.
